'''Warad Kaalt''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Kaalt also provided the knowledge of [[Synthweaver|synthweaving]] to others.
